intended_object: The smooth representative of an L² vector field on the cylinder whose translation orbit is smooth: a smooth function equal to u almost everywhere. Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and the lemmas representative_smooth and representative_ae.
explanation: The body uses Classical.choose on exists_smooth_representative. That theorem gives a function g on the cylinder that is smooth in every local chart (ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localFieldLift period g x) for all x) and equal to u almost everywhere for liftMeasure. So the definition is exactly "a smooth representative of the L² class", as its docstring says, and the following lemmas return both properties. The cylinder measure should give positive mass to nonempty open sets; I did not check this in the library. If it does, two continuous functions that agree almost everywhere are equal, so the choice is canonical: it is the continuous version of u. The definition is specific to the project's fixed cylinder setting, and its content depends on that setting. Mathlib has no general smooth/continuous-representative construction for L^p classes that this narrows down. Hence faithful. One could also read it as a proof-internal choice device, but its uniqueness makes it a genuine object.
